content.short: Paj is an offramp letting users convert crypto to fiat directly from their own wallet.
content.description: Paj focuses on the offramp direction, converting crypto to fiat straight from a user's existing wallet without first moving funds to an exchange account. Monad's documentation lists it among onramps. Cashing out is consistently the more neglected half of the flow, and often the step where a self-custody user is forced back into a custodial service.
